name: Mushroom Town - West Entrance
overview_text: Mushroom Town - West Entrance is a town in Maple Road, Maple Island in MapleStory Classic. Hosts 2 NPCs including Heena and Sera. Connects to 1 other map.
safe_zone_text: Safe zone. NPCs and portals, no mobs.

npcs.name: Heena
idle_speech_lines: Press the left Alt key to jump.
Press the arrow keys to move left and right.

npcs.name: Sera
idle_speech_lines: It's a never-ending pile of laundry. I'll be here awhile.
Have you met my sister Heena yet?
Just press the Up arrow to climb a ladder or rope.
Click on me to start a chat!

to_portal.derivation: reverse lookup: the unique portal in the destination map whose to_map_id is this map; "none" when no such portal exists

bounds_px_derived.derivation: x in [-center_x_px, width_px - center_x_px], y in [-center_y_px, height_px - center_y_px] (viewer formula left% = (x + miniMapCenterX) / minimapWidth)

gaps: to_portal (destination portal name) is not given by MeowDB; derived by reverse lookup (see to_portal_derivation).
Portal "type" is a raw integer; MeowDB does not label its meaning on the page or in the viewer code.
No foothold/platform/ladder/rope geometry is published on the page (only point positions and the minimap rectangle).
MeowDB does not say whether npc/spawn y is the raw WZ life y or the foothold-snapped y.
No monsters on this map (MeowDB lists none).
